title: Bone Density (DEXA) Scans — T-scores, Fracture Risk and Exercise

hook.en: A DEXA report gives a "T-score" that patients often fear. Learn what it measures, what the numbers mean and how to use the result to plan safe, bone-friendly exercise.
hook.ur: DEXA report "T-score" deti hai jis se mareez aksar dartay hain. Seekhein yeh kya naapta hai, numbers ka matlab kya hai aur nateeje ko hadi-dost mehfooz exercise ke plan ke liye kaise istemal karein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain what a DEXA scan measures, read a T-score and a Z-score, name the WHO categories, understand why a score is not the same as fracture risk and plan exercise safely around it.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke DEXA scan kya naapta hai, T-score aur Z-score parhenge, WHO categories batayenge, samjhenge ke score fracture ke khatre ke barabar kyun nahi aur us ke gird mehfooz exercise ka plan banayenge.

text.en: **DEXA** (dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry) uses a very low radiation dose to measure **bone mineral density** at the **spine and hip**. The result is given as a **T-score**: how many standard deviations the patient's bone density is from the average of a healthy young adult. By the WHO definition: **normal is -1.0 or higher, low bone mass (osteopenia) is between -1.0 and -2.5, and osteoporosis is -2.5 or lower**. A **Z-score** compares the patient with people of the same age and sex and is used in younger people.
text.ur: **DEXA** (dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry) bohat kam radiation se **reedh aur hip** par **haddi ki mineral density** naapta hai. Nateeja **T-score** mein hota hai: mareez ki haddi ki density sehatmand jawan ke ausat se kitne standard deviations door hai. WHO ki tareef: **normal -1.0 ya zyada, kam haddi (osteopenia) -1.0 se -2.5 ke beech, aur osteoporosis -2.5 ya kam**. **Z-score** mareez ka muqabla usi umar aur jins ke logon se karta hai aur jawan logon mein istemal hota hai.

text.en: Think of bone density as **the thickness of a wall**. A T-score tells you how thick the wall is compared with a new building. But how likely the wall is to fall in a storm also depends on its shape, its age and the wind (falls, age, past fractures). That is why a score is a piece of the picture and not the whole risk.
text.ur: Haddi ki density ko **deewar ki motai** samjhein. T-score batata hai deewar naye makan ke muqable mein kitni moti hai. Magar toofan mein deewar girne ka imkaan us ki shakl, umar aur hawa (girna, umar, pichle fractures) par bhi munhasir hai. Isi liye score tasveer ka hissa hai, poora khatra nahi.

steps.title: Read the sites and the scores
steps.detail: Check the spine, hip (total and femoral neck) and sometimes the forearm. The lowest T-score at the main sites is used for the category. || Sites aur scores parhein

steps.title: Check for traps
steps.detail: Arthritis in the spine, a previous fracture or calcified vessels can falsely raise the spine reading. Check whether there was a vertebral fracture assessment, which finds spine fractures without a full X-ray. || Jaal check karein

steps.title: Combine with fracture risk
steps.detail: Fracture risk depends on age, previous fractures, falls, family history, steroids and other factors. Tools such as FRAX combine them. Ask what the doctor's overall risk estimate is. || Fracture ke khatre se milayein

steps.title: Plan exercise and falls prevention
steps.detail: Use weight-bearing, resistance and balance exercise for every category, adjust impact and spine loading for severe osteoporosis or a spine fracture, and teach falls prevention. || Exercise aur girne se bachao ka plan

question.ur: WHO ki tareef ke mutabiq osteoporosis ka T-score kitna hai?

feedback.ur: Haan — osteopenia -1.0 se -2.5 ke beech hai.

rows.en: Prevent falls first, protect the spine

text.en: **Score plus story.** A T-score tells you the bone density; the patient's age, falls and fractures tell you the risk. Plan exercise for the whole person, and do not label anyone as "fragile".
text.ur: **Score aur kahani.** T-score haddi ki density batata hai; mareez ki umar, girna aur fractures khatra batate hain. Poore shakhs ke liye exercise ka plan banayein, aur kisi ko "kamzor" ka label na dein.

text.en: **Telling a patient with osteopenia or osteoporosis to avoid exercise.** Inactivity makes bone and muscle weaker and falls more likely. Exercise is safe and part of treatment. Adjust it for the spine and the risk of falls, rather than stopping.
text.ur: **Osteopenia ya osteoporosis ke mareez ko exercise se bachne ko kehna.** Be-harkati haddi aur muscle kamzor karti hai aur girna zyada mumkin banati hai. Exercise mehfooz hai aur ilaj ka hissa hai. Reedh aur girne ke khatre ke mutabiq badlein, rokein nahi.

question.en: A DEXA report says osteopenia at the hip but the patient has had two low-trauma fractures. What is most important?
question.ur: DEXA report mein hip par osteopenia hai magar mareez ko do halke-trauma ke fractures ho chuke hain. Sab se ahem kya hai?

text.ur: Use tamam exercise band karni chahiye

text.ur: Fracture ki history zyada khatra dikhati hai, is liye use medical assessment aur girne se bachao aur taaqat ka plan chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — prior fractures are among the strongest predictors, whatever the T-score.
feedback.ur: Haan — pichle fractures sab se mazboot peshgoiyon mein hain, T-score kuch bhi ho.

question.en: Which spine finding can falsely raise a DEXA reading?
question.ur: Reedh ki kaun si finding DEXA reading ko ghalat taur par barha sakti hai?

text.en: Spinal arthritis or a vertebral fracture
text.ur: Reedh ki arthritis ya vertebral fracture

feedback.en: Yes — extra bone in the scan area adds to the reading.
feedback.ur: Haan — scan ke hissay mein zyada haddi reading mein shamil hoti hai.

text.en: **Give a hopeful, active message.** For example: "Your bones are a little thinner than average, which is common. Bone responds to load, so we will build strength, balance and walking, and your doctor will advise on treatment." Avoid words like "brittle" or "crumbling".
text.ur: **Ummeed aur harkat ka paigham dein.** Maslan: "Aap ki haddiyan ausat se thori patli hain, jo aam hai. Haddi load par jawab deti hai, is liye hum taaqat, balance aur chalna banayenge, aur aap ka doctor ilaj ka mashwara dega." "Brittle" ya "bhurbhura" jaise alfaz se bachein.

question.en: Why is the T-score not the same as fracture risk?
question.ur: T-score fracture ke khatre ke barabar kyun nahi?

answer.en: Most fractures happen in people whose T-score is in the osteopenia range or only just in the osteoporosis range, because they are more numerous. Fractures also depend on falls, bone quality and structure, age and previous fractures, none of which the density score alone captures.
answer.ur: Zyada tar fractures un logon mein hote hain jin ka T-score osteopenia ki range mein ya osteoporosis ki hadd par hota hai, kyunke woh zyada hote hain. Fractures girne, haddi ki quality aur saakht, umar aur pichle fractures par bhi munhasir hain, jinhein akela density score nahi pakarta.

beats.patient: A 66-year-old woman has a hip T-score of -2.7 and no fractures. She is active and fears she will "break a bone" if she exercises. Her balance is good.
beats.assessment: She has osteoporosis by density, with no fractures or falls, so exercise is safe and helpful with sensible spine care.
beats.treatment: Explain, teach resistance and balance exercises, safe lifting with a hip hinge, avoid loaded spinal flexion, and encourage her doctor's treatment and calcium and vitamin D as advised.
beats.reassess: At three months she is stronger and confident, and her balance remains good.

text.en: **Seek medical review** for sudden new back pain or loss of height (a possible vertebral fracture), a fall with severe pain, or new weakness or numbness. After a fracture, follow the surgeon's advice before loading the area. Do not advise starting, stopping or changing osteoporosis medicines.
text.ur: **Medical review karwayein** achanak nayi peeth ka dard ya qad mein kami (mumkin vertebral fracture), girne ke baad shadeed dard, ya nayi kamzori ya sunn hona. Fracture ke baad hissay par load se pehle surgeon ka mashwara maanein. Osteoporosis ki dawaiyan shuru, band ya badalne ka mashwara na dein.

summary.en: DEXA measures bone density at the spine and hip; the T-score classifies it (normal -1.0 or higher, osteopenia -1.0 to -2.5, osteoporosis -2.5 or lower).
summary.ur: DEXA reedh aur hip par haddi ki density naapta hai; T-score isay classify karta hai (normal -1.0 ya zyada, osteopenia -1.0 se -2.5, osteoporosis -2.5 ya kam).

summary.en: Fracture risk also depends on age, falls and previous fractures, so read the score with the patient's story.
summary.ur: Fracture ka khatra umar, girne aur pichle fractures par bhi munhasir hai, is liye score ko mareez ki kahani ke saath parhein.

summary.en: Exercise is safe and part of treatment: weight-bearing, resistance and balance training with sensible spine care and falls prevention.
summary.ur: Exercise mehfooz hai aur ilaj ka hissa: wazan uthane wali, resistance aur balance training, reedh ki ehtiyat aur girne se bachao ke saath.

back.en: Bone mineral density, usually at the spine and hip.
back.ur: Haddi ki mineral density, aam taur par reedh aur hip par.

back.en: A comparison with people of the same age and sex.
back.ur: Usi umar aur jins ke logon se muqabla.

front.en: Name one thing that raises fracture risk beyond the score.
front.ur: Score ke ilawa fracture ka khatra barhane wali ek cheez batayein.

back.en: A previous fracture, falls, older age or steroid use.
back.ur: Pichla fracture, girna, zyada umar ya steroid ka istemal.

note.ur: Kamzor haddi ke saath mehfooz exercise.
